title: Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Larch is a startup building travel apps. We are looking for a mid-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Eastmere office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will review code with the team, ship features end to end and work closely with design and product.

Four-day weeks in summer.
